name: RAM
comment: main memory's first guest address

name: RETAIL_RAM_SIZE
comment: the retail 24 MiB

name: WINDOW
comment: the mod's data window: no guest memory is behind it

name: IMAGE
comment: the mod image's bytes ('FZMD'): its routines run as native code; the bytes here serve the words those routines read from their own image

name: SLOT
comment: the seat routines' slot 'FZSI': +4 seat, +32 off, +36 uniform, +40 player seats (bit i = seat i), +44 input delay

name: CONTROL
comment: the frame routine's control block (netframe.py lists every word)

name: CHECKSUMS
comment: the checksum ring: 1024 x u32, entry step & 1023

name: SMOOTH
comment: rivals' drawn offsets (smooth.py)

name: NAMES
comment: player names: 30 x NAME_SIZE bytes, NUL-terminated, seat order; empty: the pilot's name

name: RACE
comment: the race block 'FZRC'

name: RACE_COURSE
comment: words

name: RACE_MACHINES
comment: 30 bytes, seat 0 first

name: RACE_CPULEVEL
comment: the host's rules: words

name: RACE_SETTINGS
comment: 30 bytes

name: MODE
comment: what the game was started for, tested by every routine at a patched site: 0 a plain start (the stock game's behaviour), 1 a race (a match file, or a replay played as the race)

name: PRELOAD
comment: the results screen's pictures read before the race (port/image/build.py): +0 state (2 read, 3 not read), three pairs (bitmap group, the packed file's address), +28 loads served from memory, +32 the main heap's largest free block when it was tried

name: END_OFFICIAL
comment: the race's end, held until it is official: the host's word, every step below this one ran, or runs in this frame, with the official inputs (0: never said)

name: END_ASKED
comment: the image's: 1, the race looks over on steps not yet official; the host's next frame checks them, runs no new step, and clears it

name: END_OVER
comment: the image's: 1, its race-over test said "over": the host predicts no step from here

name: HOST_NET
comment: host calls (nothing is behind these addresses): the network hook

name: HOST_TICK
comment: every game frame of a race or replay start, from the mode machine's routine

name: HOST_LINKED
comment: main.rel is linked and none of its code has run

name: MAIN_REL
comment: main.rel's module header in every boot (the pin)

name: INPUTS
comment: the input buffer: 1024 steps x 30 seats x 8 bytes (a 6-byte control record each)
